text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Overshoot when the input recovers: 27 % with anti-windup, 106 % without. The difference is entirely what

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: the integrator stored during the six milliseconds its output was pinned to the limit, and it gets worse

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: the deeper the sag: a sag to 12 V costs 47 %, to 11 V costs 75 %, to 10 V costs 106 %.
